Runes

Every rune for patch 26.22. You pick a primary tree (a keystone plus three runes) and a secondary tree (two runes). New to runes? Read Summoner Spells and Runes. Looking for items? See all items.

Domination

Domination is about burst damage and hunting: deal a lot of damage quickly, then get rewarded for kills. Assassins, burst mages and aggressive junglers take it.

Keystones
ElectrocuteHit an enemy champion with 3 separate attacks or abilities within 3 seconds to deal a burst of bonus damage.
Dark HarvestDamaging a champion below 50% health deals bonus damage and collects a soul, which makes Dark Harvest stronger for the rest of the game.
Hail of BladesYour next 3 attacks on an enemy champion are much faster and deal a bit of bonus true damage.
Row 1
Cheap ShotDamaging a champion who is slowed, stunned or otherwise impaired deals a little bonus true damage.
Taste of BloodHeal a small amount when you damage an enemy champion, once every 20 seconds.
Sudden ImpactAfter you dash, blink, teleport or leave stealth, your next damage on a champion deals bonus true damage.
Row 2
Sixth SenseAutomatically spots a nearby hidden enemy ward and tracks it for your team, with a long cooldown.
Grisly MementosEach champion takedown gives a memento (up to 18), and each memento makes your trinket come back faster.
Deep WardYour wards in the enemy jungle get 1 extra health and last longer; from level 9 river wards get this too.
Row 3
Treasure HunterThe first takedown on each enemy champion gives you extra gold, and the bonus grows with each new champion you take down.
Relentless HunterGain move speed out of combat for each enemy champion you have taken down at least once.
Ultimate HunterYour ultimate gets ability haste, plus more for each enemy champion you have taken down at least once.
Inspiration

Inspiration is a toolbox of unusual effects: extra gold, free items, potions and summoner spell tricks. It is most often a secondary tree for players who want lane sustain or faster summoner spells.

Keystones
Glacial AugmentStunning, rooting or otherwise immobilizing an enemy creates frozen zones that slow enemies and make them deal less damage to your allies.
Unsealed SpellbookLets you swap one of your summoner spells for a different single-use summoner spell during the game, starting at 6 minutes.
First StrikeIf you hit an enemy champion first when a fight starts, you deal 7% extra damage for 3 seconds and turn part of that damage into gold.
Row 1
Hextech FlashtraptionWhile Flash is on cooldown, you get Hexflash: channel for 2 seconds to blink to a new spot.
Magical FootwearYou get free Slightly Magical Footwear at 12 minutes, sooner if you get takedowns, but you cannot buy boots before then.
Cash BackGet 7.5% of the gold back when you buy a legendary item.
Row 2
Triple TonicYou get free elixirs at levels 3, 6 and 9: Elixir of Avarice, Elixir of Force and Elixir of Skill.
Time Warp TonicWhen you drink a potion, 40% of its healing happens instantly instead of over time.
Biscuit DeliveryYou get a free Total Biscuit of Everlasting Will every 2 minutes until 6 minutes, and each one you eat gives 30 max health permanently.
Row 3
Cosmic InsightYour summoner spells and item actives come back faster.
Approach VelocityGain move speed toward nearby enemy champions who are slowed or stunned, with a bigger bonus if you caused it.
Jack Of All TradesEach different stat you get from items gives 1 ability haste, plus bonus adaptive force at 5 and 10 different stats.
Precision

Precision is about winning longer fights with basic attacks: attack speed, healing and extra damage that grows the longer you fight. Marksmen and melee fighters who hit enemies over and over take it.

Keystones
Press the AttackHit an enemy champion with 3 basic attacks in a row to deal bonus damage. After that, all your damage is 8% higher until you leave combat with champions.
Lethal TempoAttacking enemy champions gives you stacking attack speed, and at 6 stacks your attacks deal bonus damage.
Fleet FootworkMoving and attacking charges up an attack that heals you and gives a short burst of move speed.
ConquerorDamaging enemy champions builds stacks of extra damage, and at 12 stacks you heal for part of the damage you deal.
Row 1
Absorb LifeKilling a target, including minions, heals you.
TriumphChampion takedowns restore some of your health and give 20 extra gold.
Presence of MindDamaging an enemy champion gives back some mana or energy, and takedowns restore 15% of your max mana or energy.
Row 2
Legend: AlacrityGain attack speed, which grows as you earn Legend stacks from kills, monsters and minions.
Legend: HasteGain basic ability haste, which grows as you earn Legend stacks from kills, monsters and minions.
Legend: BloodlineGain life steal as you earn Legend stacks, and 85 max health once you reach all 15 stacks.
Row 3
Coup de GraceDeal 8% more damage to champions below 40% health.
Cut DownDeal 8% more damage to champions above 60% health.
Last StandDeal more damage to champions while you are below 60% health, up to the max bonus at 30% health.
Resolve

Resolve is about staying alive: extra health, armor, magic resist, healing and shields. Tanks, frontline supports and durable top laners take it.

Keystones
Grasp of the UndyingEvery 4 seconds in combat, your next attack on a champion deals bonus damage based on your max health, heals you and gives you 5 permanent health.
AftershockAfter you immobilize an enemy champion, you gain lots of armor and magic resist for 2.5 seconds, then explode for damage around you.
GuardianProtects nearby allies and allies you target with spells, giving both of you a shield if one of you takes enough damage.
Row 1
DemolishEvery 30 seconds, your third attack on a tower deals bonus damage based on your max health.
Font of LifeSlowing, rooting or otherwise impairing an enemy champion heals you and the lowest-health nearby ally.
Shield BashWhenever you get a new shield, your next attack on a champion deals bonus damage.
Row 2
ConditioningAfter 12 minutes, gain 8 armor and 8 magic resist, plus 3% more of both.
Second WindAfter an enemy champion damages you, heal for part of your missing health over 10 seconds.
Bone PlatingAfter an enemy champion damages you, their next 3 hits on you deal less damage.
Row 3
OvergrowthMinions and monsters dying near you give you permanent max health, plus a bigger bonus after 120 of them.
RevitalizeGain 5% heal and shield power, and heals and shields are stronger on targets below 40% health.
UnflinchingGain 10 armor and magic resist while crowd controlled and for 2 seconds after.
Sorcery

Sorcery is about spells: ability damage, mana, cooldowns and movement speed. Mages, poke champions and many supports take it.

Keystones
Summon AeryDamaging enemies sends Aery to deal a little damage, and helping allies with abilities sends Aery to shield them.
Arcane CometDamaging a champion with an ability drops a comet on them, which deals more damage the farther away you are.
Stormraider's SurgeDealing 25% of a champion's max health within 3 seconds gives you a big burst of move speed and slow resistance for 4 seconds.
Deathfire TouchDamaging a champion with an ability sets them on fire, and the burn gets stronger if they keep burning for 3 seconds.
Row 1
Axiom ArcanistYour ultimate deals more damage and gives more healing and shielding, and takedowns lower its current cooldown.
Manaflow BandHitting enemy champions with abilities raises your max mana by 25 at a time, up to 250, then slowly restores mana.
Nimbus CloakAfter you use a summoner spell, gain a short burst of move speed and walk through units.
Row 2
TranscendenceGain ability haste at levels 5 and 8, and from level 11 takedowns lower your basic ability cooldowns.
CelerityGain 1% move speed, and all move speed bonuses are 7% more effective on you.
Absolute FocusWhile above 70% health, gain bonus attack damage or ability power.
Row 3
ScorchYour next damaging ability on a champion sets them on fire for a little bonus damage, every 10 seconds.
WaterwalkingGain move speed and bonus damage while in the river.
Gathering StormEvery 10 minutes, gain bonus attack damage or ability power, and the bonus grows the longer the game lasts.
